package.description: A Speakr companion that records both sides of your meetings and calls and sends them to your Speakr server for transcripts and summaries.

en-US.author: Feridoun
en-US.description: A Speakr companion that records both sides of your meetings and calls and sends them to your Speakr server for transcripts and summaries.
en-US.longDescription:
A small Windows tray app for people who use Speakr, the self-hosted transcription server. It records meetings and calls (Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, WhatsApp, softphones) and uploads them to your Speakr server for transcripts and summaries.
It records your microphone mixed with your PC's playback audio, so both sides are captured without a virtual audio cable. It notices when a meeting starts and offers to record it, or one hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+R) starts and stops recording. Recordings are written to disk as they're made, uploads are retried while offline, and Sensitive mode keeps a recording on the PC only.
en-US.name: MeetingRecorder
en-US.releaseNotes: The publisher is now shown as Feridoun. Since 1.3.0, CallRecorder is MeetingRecorder, and it can notice when a meeting or call starts and offer to record it. Upgrading moves your settings, recordings, Speakr token and Start at login setting over.
